title: NIST SP 800-84：訓練、測試與演練的證據型別矩陣
titleEn: NIST SP 800-84: evidence types for training, tests and exercises
subcategoryTitle: 事件演練、服務恢復與可驗證交接
subcategoryTitleEn: Incident exercises, service recovery and verifiable handoffs
summary: 將需求拆成知識、工具功能與協作決策三種，指定每種可接受證據；建立需求到證據的多對多映射與不適用標記。
summaryEn: Classify requirements as knowledge, tool function or coordinated decision-making and specify acceptable evidence for each. Build a many-to-many requirement-to-evidence map with explicit not-applicable states.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 定義需求與適切證據
stages.description: 團隊把完成教學影片當作實際復原測試通過，也把熟悉腳本的演練表現當成無提示能力；本課用證據型別避免不同活動互相冒充。 將需求拆成知識、工具功能與協作決策三種，指定每種可接受證據；建立需求到證據的多對多映射與不適用標記。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 建立12列需求與每個可接受evidence_type清單，證據檔另有operator、observed_action及result。附件存在但缺結果應算未滿足；同一檔可支持多項僅在每項都有可定位觀察，不能用單一簽到檔滿足全部。
stages.descriptionEn: A team treats watching a training video as a passed recovery test and rehearsed performance as unaided capability. An evidence-type matrix prevents unlike activities from substituting for one another. Classify requirements as knowledge, tool function or coordinated decision-making and specify acceptable evidence for each. Build a many-to-many requirement-to-evidence map with explicit not-applicable states. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Create twelve requirement rows with acceptable evidence_type lists. Each artifact records operator, observed_action and result. A file that exists without an observed result remains insufficient. One artifact can support several requirements only where each has a locatable observation; a single attendance file cannot satisfy all requirements.
